sn47.20:1.2: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sumbhesu viharati Sedakam nāma Sumbhānaṃ nigamo || || 2.
sn47.20:2.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave Janapadakalyāṇī janapadakalyāṇī ti kho bhikkhave mahājanakāyo sannipateyya ||
sn47.20:2.2: Sā kho panassa janapadakalyāṇī paramapāsāvinī nacce paramapāsāvinī gīte ||
sn47.20:2.3: Janapadakalyāṇī naccati gāyatīti kho bhikkhave bhiyyosomattāya mahā janakāyo sannipateyya || ||
sn47.20:2.4: Atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikūlo
sn47.20:2.6: Ayan te ambho purisa samatittiko telapatto antarena ca mahāsamajjam antarena ca janapadakalyāṇiṃ parihātabbo ||
sn47.20:2.7: puriso ca te ukkhitāsiko piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhissati
sn47.20:2.8: yattheva naṃ thokam pi chaddessati tattheva te siro pātessatī ti || ||
sn47.20:2.10: api nu so puriso amum telapattam amanasikaritvā bahiddhā pamādam āhareyyāti || ||
sn47.20:3.1: Upamā kho myāyam bhikkhave katā atthassa viññāpanāya ||
sn47.20:3.3: Samatittiko telapatto ti kho bhikkhave kāyagatāya etaṃ satiyā adhivacanaṃ || || 5.
sn47.20:3.4: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evam sikkhitabbaṃ || ||
sn47.20:3.5: Kāyagatā sati no bhāvitā bhavissati bahulīkatā yānikatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā ti || Evaṃ
